answer: Shared Beacon Registration. Each wallet must periodically submit a random challenge to a public beacon; the operator’s signing key is embedded in every agent it spawns. Duplicate identities are detected when two wallets answer the same beacon pulse with the same operator key, and the plume of forfeited prepaid service credits—not wallet balances—is slashed. The hollow part: operators must pre-fund a distinct escrow per active identity, so each Sybil copy costs a fresh, non-recoverable deposit.
